vanilla_tooltips.config.title: Vanilla Tooltips Settings
vanilla_tooltips.config.reset.tooltip: Reset all settings to their default values.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.enab: Enables or disables the custom item tooltip styling.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.show: Shows item rarity on a separate line beneath the item name.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.rari: Shows or hides the outline around the tooltip.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.tool: Outline color for common items; in Gradient mode, this is the base of a matching two-color vertical gradient.
Outline color for uncommon items; in Gradient mode, this is the base of a matching two-color vertical gradient.
Outline color for rare items; in Gradient mode, this is the base of a matching two-color vertical gradient.
Outline color for epic items; in Gradient mode, this is the base of a matching two-color vertical gradient.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.show: Shows the item inside a compact frame beside its name.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.anim: Animates the framed item when its tooltip appears.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.item: Changes the size of the item inside its frame.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.anim: Controls how quickly the item appears.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.item: Sets the color and opacity of the background inside the item preview frame.
Choose a standard frame color, rarity-specific colors, a two-color vertical gradient matched to each rarity, or a custom color.
Sets one frame color for all items.
Choose a standard background color, rarity-specific colors, a two-color vertical gradient matched to each rarity, or a custom color.

vanilla_tooltips.config.description.show: Shows wearable armor on a separate 3D model.
vanilla_tooltips.config.description.armo: Changes the size of the armor preview.

Controls how quickly the armor preview rotates.
Selects the direction in which the armor preview rotates.
